variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes down government bill
variants.sub: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government.
variants.body:
A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A bill that has been rejected is not a new operating rule. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
